note: 20 s silent test: 5 independent shots x 4 s. Every shot starts from a still that ALREADY contains everything in frame, so nothing can pop in mid-shot (the spear did). No camera move on architecture (the gate grew). One motion per sentence, camera clause first, no static re-description, no negative block — the Wan 2 I2V contract in studio/knowledge/prompting/WAN_PROMPTS.md.

shots.prompt: The camera holds still. He walks away up the road, one step after another, his coat swinging at his calves. He does not look back.
The camera holds still. He walks on across the wet courtyard, away from the lens, one step after another, the rain slanting down past his shoulders.
The camera holds still. Rain begins to fall through the lantern light. She blinks once and her shoulders settle as she breathes out.
The camera holds still. The fingers tighten once around the shaft and a bead of water runs off the knuckle.
The camera holds still. She lifts her chin and looks past the lens, her eyes narrowing slightly, rain running down her cheek.
